policy.requirement: Disclose material AI assistance and confirm human review.

gates.fit_scope: One confirmed bug with no unrelated refactoring.
gates.correctness_tests: Regression test failed before the change and passed after it.
gates.accessibility: No user-interface change; existing accessibility tests pass.
gates.security_privacy: No private data, credentials, or authorization changes.
gates.license_provenance: Dependencies and copied material were checked; no new dependency.
gates.standards_compatibility: No public interface or standard version changes.
gates.sustainability_review_burden: The diff is focused and deterministic checks replace further model review.
gates.disclosure: Required tool, uses, and human verification are included.
